ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Individual research in an area of materials science and engineering under the supervision of members of the staff. Results of research may be used for a senior (undergraduate) thesis. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. 1 to 5 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. A minimum total credit of 3 undergraduate hours is required. Prerequisite: Senior standing, grade point average of 3.0 or better, and consent of instructor.
